title: 'We have to grow some bigger balls' recommends Latvian Prime Minister
summary_full: Latvian Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) did not mince his words at the informal meeting of the heads of state or government of the European Union (EU) in Dublin, Ireland, on November 13th, recommending a testosterone-filled course of action for the continent.
